meta.name: The Completely Made Up Adventures of Dick Turpin
meta.description: Legendary highwayman Dick Turpin sets out on a series of wildly absurd escapades when he's made the reluctant leader of a band of outlaws—and tasked with outwitting utterly corrupt lawman Jonathan Wilde.

videos.title: A Legend Is Born (Sort Of)
videos.overview: Destiny calls when butcher's assistant Dick Turpin befriends a gang of outlaws and steps into the swashbuckling spotlight.

videos.title: The Unrobbable Coach
videos.overview: In a bid to prove himself to the highwaymen, Dick vows to rob a cursed stagecoach... and faces the consequences. Nell explores a new opportunity.

videos.title: Run Wilde
videos.overview: The gang's trip to London dissolves into chaos when a gold deal falls apart. Wilde faces pressure to end Dick once and for all.

videos.title: Tommy Silversides
videos.overview: Rivalry ensues as a dashing new highwayman bursts onto the scene and challenges Dick to a duel. Helen makes a promising offer.

videos.title: Turpin Time
videos.overview: Hempstead's new normal proves to be a harsh reality. Can Dick saddle up and save the day?
